disposition_reason: Cadmium and lead were measured by ICP-MS in locally grown market basket produce from SW and NE Britain; Tables 2 to 5 give n, mean, minimum, median and maximum in ng/g fresh weight.

study.design: Market basket surveys of locally grown produce (SW Britain 630 samples, NE Britain 190 samples, plus alternative preparations) and a SW field survey with soils (figure-only)
study.origin: locally grown in SW Britain (Devon, Cornwall) and NE Britain (Aberdeenshire)
study.market: wide range of retailers in each region (sampling described in Norton et al. 2013)
study.method: Washed, pureed, oven-dried 70 °C (moisture recorded), HNO3/H2O2 microwave digestion; ICP-MS (Agilent 7500) with Rh internal standard; LA-ICP-MS for potato localisation (qualitative)
lod: Not stated for basket data (floor values 1.8 ng/g Cd and 4.0 ng/g Pb appear in tables); baked potato flesh Pb LOD 8 ng/g f.wt
study.qa: CRM recoveries (Table 1): Cd 83.5-93.5% in plant CRMs; Pb 70.1-91.1% (low recovery for herbs and tobacco CRMs)
